subject: Purchase path outline & MAPlet draft
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@avahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Purchase path outline & MAPlet draft

Hi Liam — great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and a lightweight MAP ("MAPlet") so your team can share a single artifact with procurement/security: 

1) Economic decision criteria (what will win):
- Total cost per 1M tokens/month (redwood-hosted) incl. support and ingress/egress estimates
- Latency at 95th percentile under expected traffic profile (conversational + batch inferencing)
- Data residency & audit log retention options (30/90/365 day patterns)

2) Primary stakeholders you mentioned:
- Economic buyer: Nimesh Patel (Head of Procurement) — confirmed budget window May 2027
- Security owner: Liam O'Connor (InfoSec/Policy) — needs SOC2 + evidence on audit logs, KMS integration
- Technical champion: Dr. Priya Rao (NLP Lead) — POC owner and model-quality gatekeeper

3) Key procurement gates and timeline (your inputs):
- Security questionnaire (you: week of May 3)
- Legal redlines (procurement timeline: 2–3 weeks after security greenlight)
- Exec signoff & budget release target: May 20–27

Next steps I propose:
- Attach a one-page MAPlet (RDW_MAP_draft_20270427.xlsx) for you to circulate — includes milestone owners and decision criteria.
- I will attach the latest AVA security Q&A (pdf) for your SecOps review.
- Let's lock a 30-min sync with procurement + security next Thursday 4/29. Proposed slots: 10:00 PT or 14:00 PT.

Attachments: RDW_MAP_draft_20270427.xlsx (spreadsheet), AVA_Security_QA_v2.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — happy to make the MAPlet shorter/longer depending on who you want to share it with.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.ai]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@avahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nimesh Patel <nimesh.p@avahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase path outline & MAPlet draft

Karthik — thanks for the concise recap. Quick notes from our side: 

- Nimesh will be the budget owner but wants to see clear SLAs and an option for predictable monthly reserved capacity. He asked me to confirm whether Dedicated capacity pricing is available as a fast-follow quote.
- I briefly checked the AVA_Security_QA_v2.pdf you attached and we have two immediate asks: explicit audit-log retention duration options per environment, and confirmation that key rotation can be customer-managed (KMS).
- Procurement prefers a single MAP artifact — your RDW_MAP_draft_20270427.xlsx looks like a good start. One small ask: add a column for "decision input" that lists the doc or metric that will satisfy each gate (e.g., SOC2 report link, latency bench).

We can do Thursday 4/29 at 10:00 PT. Please send a calendar invite and a short agenda (30 min).

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of InfoSec, Ava Health
liam.oconnor@avahealth.com
